tip: Front the object and the verb still stays second, so the subject comes after: Kaffe dricker jag, not Kaffe jag dricker.
Det var X som is a cleft that spotlights one part: Det var igår som jag träffade henne highlights when, not what.
Adjective plus som plus subject means as or though: Trött som jag var = tired as I was.
Se fram emot is a fixed three-word phrase for look forward to: Han ser fram emot semestern.
Vända sig till needs a reflexive matching the subject: Jag vänder mig till er = I approach you.
Vore is the subjunctive of vara, used for polite hypotheticals: Jag vore tacksam om ni kunde.
